subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping & evidence delivery for HearthBank POC
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@hearthbank.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ control mapping & evidence request for Redwood POC

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. As part of our security review for the upcoming POC, security asked us to collect a CAIQ-style mapping of Redwood's controls to the CSA framework and to stage evidence for a short review window. Specifically HearthBank is asking for:

- A mapping spreadsheet that shows control IDs we care about (IWM, CC, CM families) and where Redwood's docs/evidence live.
- Relevant log samples or runbook snippets for controls around key management, KV caching isolation, and runtime telemetry (we called these out as CC-5, CM-8, and IWM-2 in our internal shorthand).
- A short timeline for delivery (we're trying to get an initial pass for legal + security by next Monday).

I've attached our selection of CAIQ questions that the security team prioritized (attachment: HearthBank_CAIQ_Selection.xlsx). Please confirm scope — this is for the sandbox POC tenant only, not production — and let me know a point of contact on your side who will own the evidence drops.

Appreciate it —
Liam
Senior Security Analyst
HearthBank Security

(attachment: HearthBank_CAIQ_Selection.xlsx)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@hearthbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 16:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping & evidence request for Redwood POC

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Confirming scope: sandbox POC tenant only.

Plan & owners:
- I'll produce an initial CAIQ mapping workbook that ties Redwood controls to the CAIQ questions you flagged and mark which artifacts we can provide right away.
- Kimberly will pull runtime/telemetry log excerpts and the KV isolation notes.
- Marissa will gather infra diagrams and the Docs/attestations.

Timeline: initial mapping (spreadsheet + annotated pointers) by Thu EOD (48 hours). Evidence bundle (zipped artifacts + sample logs) within 5 business days unless we hit an access snag. If you need a narrower subset sooner let me know which controls to prioritize and we can fast-track.

I've attached the first draft workbook (attachment: CAIQ_Mapping_HearthBank_v1.xlsx) — it's a live sheet; we'll iterate. Also linking an internal runbook excerpt we'll use to pull log slices.

Next steps for you: confirm the POC tenant ID (or just confirm 'sandbox' is fine) and whether DocuSign access is required for any NDA/POC agreement.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com

(attachment: CAIQ_Mapping_HearthBank_v1.xlsx)
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-HEARTH-CAIQ

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@hearthbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@hearthbank.com
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 09:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping & evidence request for Redwood POC

Jordan — thanks, that timeline works. Sandbox confirmed. A few clarifications from security:

- They specifically asked for a KV access log sample showing tenant separation traces (last 30 days, redacted) and a note on how prefix caching is isolated per tenant.
- We also want the key rotation policy excerpt and any HSM/KMS integration diagrams for the private deploy path even if the POC is hosted.
- If possible, include a short statement on your fallback routing policies and how fallbacks degrade gracefully (this is a high-level ask; a paragraph is fine).

I've attached our POC T&C snapshot (attachment: HearthBank_POCTOC.pdf) and pasted our DocuSign link below for the POC addendum. If you prefer we can sign after the evidence pass, but security likes to see the paperwork on file.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/ABC-DEF-HEARTH-POC

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Liam

(attachment: HearthBank_POCTOC.pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 11:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping & evidence request for Redwood POC

Acknowledged — I will:
- Export a 30-day KV access slice from the sandbox namespace and redact tenant identifiers (attachment: kv_sample_logs.txt).
- Pull the key rotation policy excerpt and links to the KMS integration diagrams (private deploy).
- Draft the fallback routing blurb for the mapping workbook.

Marissa — can you attach the infra diagram pack to the shared Drive folder and add a short note on where doc sign evidence will be stored?

I'll aim to have the log slice + key policy excerpt in the Drive folder by EOD today.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior SRE, Redundancy & Runtime
